club.name: Computer Society
club.about: The IEEE Computer Society at VIT Chennai is an active club that plays a key role in shaping the college's infrastructure and supporting major events like TechnoVIT, Vibrance, and Voyage. It's a great place to grow, whether you're into tech or non-tech fields. By joining, you'll learn valuable skills and contribute meaningfully to real projects. Through our Builder's Hut initiative, you'll get hands-on experience in building products from scratch, with regular workshops, seminars, and project showcases to help you grow.
